objective: compare useful capabilities rather than claim unrestricted equivalence from one score

policy.external_core_role: authorized knowledge feed and charging/support only

dimensions.question: Can the system map varied Portuguese language to stable semantic intent and entities?
dimensions.metric: exact semantic parse, slot accuracy, abstention risk-coverage
dimensions.current_evidence: controlled semantic compiler plus bounded language OOD contract
dimensions.current_result: 14/14 language OOD cases; 5/5 critical language mutants killed
dimensions.scope_limit: not open-domain language understanding or LLM parity
dimensions.release_gate: frozen Portuguese paraphrase set with held-out syntax and human-reviewed canonical IR

dimensions.question: Can known atoms and rules be recombined in unseen structures?
dimensions.metric: structured exact match by split, depth accuracy, provenance retention
dimensions.scope_limit: typed symbolic domain; not open-domain language fluency

dimensions.question: Can the system generate useful novel language rather than fixed templates?
dimensions.metric: human-rated adequacy, semantic preservation, diversity, repetition, length control
dimensions.release_gate: same prompts, fixed decoding, blinded human evaluation and semantic oracle

dimensions.question: Does generation remain supported by current authorized memory?
dimensions.metric: support precision, unsupported-claim rate, conflict abstention, evidence coverage
dimensions.current_result: memory-grounded and conflict/expiry gates pass in host suites

dimensions.question: Does the system abstain when evidence, confidence or budget is insufficient?
dimensions.metric: risk-coverage curve, abstention precision, false-confidence rate
dimensions.current_result: typed abstention gates pass; similarity-only baseline is weaker in existing intent benchmark
dimensions.scope_limit: calibration on open language is not measured

dimensions.question: Does state remain coherent across generation, presentation, confirmation, interruption and reboot?
dimensions.metric: sequence exactness, illegal-transition count, scrub completeness, replay rejection
dimensions.scope_limit: deterministic host protocol, not human conversation

dimensions.question: Does local adaptation change only authorized presentation and forget correctly?
dimensions.metric: style accuracy, fact invariance, consent violation rate, deletion recall

dimensions.question: Can the system remain useful without granting action, leaking private text or laundering provenance?
dimensions.metric: authority violations, privacy payload retention, poisoning survival, redteam kill rate
dimensions.current_result: 276 global invariants; critical redteams pass across authority, poisoning, attribution and dialogue
dimensions.scope_limit: not a proof against all attacks

dimensions.question: Can the target run within a measured resource budget?
dimensions.metric: peak RAM, flash, latency, energy per turn, thermal behavior
dimensions.current_result: host object guardrails: generative_core 3779 text, personal_adapter 1267 text, composed_dialogue 3164 text
dimensions.scope_limit: ESP32-S3 RAM, latency, energy and thermal data pending hardware

dimensions.question: Can the person interact naturally through local voice and understand haptic output?
dimensions.metric: WER, false activation, missed capture, human decoding accuracy, latency
dimensions.current_result: HAP-SEM round-trip and non-actionability pass on host
dimensions.scope_limit: no microphone, acoustic or human perception measurement

cannot_claim_full_llm_equivalence_until: all results report coverage, abstention and confidence intervals where applicable
parity_decision_rule.acceptable_interim_claim: HERUS has verified local typed compositional, grounded and safety capabilities while open-domain LLM parity remains unmeasured.
